rows.title: How much does a carpenter make per year working in Vancouver?
rows.old_description: Follow the path behind How much does a carpenter make per year working in Vancouver? and see how real choices, training, and early experience can turn interest into direction.
rows.new_takeaway: Carpenter pay in cities like Vancouver scales sharply with years on tools. The number you find online is usually a midpoint, not what a first-year apprentice or a seasoned journeyman actually takes home.

rows.title: Hands-On Learning, Real Backyard Projects
rows.old_description: Follow the path behind Hands-On Learning, Real Backyard Projects and see how real choices, training, and early experience can turn interest into direction.
rows.new_takeaway: Real backyard projects teach what classes can't: how to estimate, sequence, and fix mistakes you made yourself. A finished shed teaches more than a finished test.

rows.title: Interviewing a Video Game Art Director
rows.old_description: Follow the path behind Interviewing a Video Game Art Director and see how real choices, training, and early experience can turn interest into direction.
rows.new_takeaway: Art direction in games is rarely a job people aim at directly. Most people who hold it spent a decade as illustrators, animators, or designers first, picking up the breadth the role actually needs.

rows.title: From Indie N00B to Creator: My Journey Making a Game with Just Art Skills!
rows.old_description: Follow the path behind From Indie N00B to Creator: My Journey Making a Game with Just Art Skills! and see how real choices, training, and early experience can turn interest into direction.
rows.new_takeaway: First indie games are almost always smaller than the developer's first idea. Shipping at all teaches more than aiming high and never releasing.

rows.title: What it's like to be a Pastry Chef
rows.old_description: Follow the path behind What it's like to be a Pastry Chef and see how real choices, training, and early experience can turn interest into direction.
rows.new_takeaway: Pastry shifts start before sunrise and end with everything you made gone by lunch. The career suits people who get satisfaction from the work itself, not from a finished product that sticks around.

rows.title: Key things to starting a successful photography business 📸
rows.old_description: Follow the path behind Key things to starting a successful photography business 📸 and see how real choices, training, and early experience can turn interest into direction.
rows.new_takeaway: Photography businesses live or die on the parts most photographers ignore: pricing, contracts, and consistent client follow-up. The shooting is the easiest part of the job.

rows.title: How much 💰 a Photographer makes and her Dream Job?
rows.old_description: Follow the path behind How much 💰 a Photographer makes and her Dream Job? and see how real choices, training, and early experience can turn interest into direction.
rows.new_takeaway: Photography pay is bimodal: most photographers earn modestly while a small group commands premium rates. The split comes down to specialization and niche reputation, not raw talent.

rows.title: Want to start a Video Production Company? START WITH WHY
rows.old_description: Follow the path behind Want to start a Video Production Company? START WITH WHY and see how real choices, training, and early experience can turn interest into direction.
rows.new_takeaway: Video production companies that last are almost always built around a clear point of view, not gear lists. Clients can find a cheaper camera; they buy your judgment.

rows.title: Should you go to university to become a chef? 👨‍🍳
rows.old_description: Follow the path behind Should you go to university to become a chef? 👨‍🍳 and see how real choices, training, and early experience can turn interest into direction.
rows.new_takeaway: Culinary school speeds the start of a chef's career, but most working chefs got there through apprenticeship and years in restaurant kitchens. The credential is optional in a way it isn't for most professions.

rows.title: How This Cabinet Maker Built a 6-Figure Career with Hard Work
rows.old_description: Follow the path behind How This Cabinet Maker Built a 6-Figure Career with Hard Work and see how real choices, training, and early experience can turn interest into direction.
rows.new_takeaway: Cabinetmakers who hit six figures usually own their work. The path runs through technical mastery, then a slow shift into estimating, client relationships, and running a small shop.

rows.title: Job Talks - Instrumentation and Control Technician - Melissa Explains What it is
rows.old_description: Follow the path behind Job Talks - Instrumentation and Control Technician - Melissa Explains What it is and see how real choices, training, and early experience can turn interest into direction.
rows.new_takeaway: Instrumentation and control techs sit at the intersection of mechanical and electrical work, with a layer of software on top. People who end up here often started in one of those fields and broadened into the others.

rows.title: Become a refrigeration mechanic
rows.old_description: Follow the path behind Become a refrigeration mechanic and see how real choices, training, and early experience can turn interest into direction.
rows.new_takeaway: Refrigeration mechanic work is steady in any climate that needs cooling, which is most of them. The path is a four-year apprenticeship and a Red Seal that travels across provinces.

rows.title: Job Talks - Refrigeration and AC Mechanic - Brandi is a Super Hero, Find Out Why!
rows.old_description: Follow the path behind Job Talks - Refrigeration and AC Mechanic - Brandi is a Super Hero, Find Out Why! and see how real choices, training, and early experience can turn interest into direction.
rows.new_takeaway: Refrigeration and AC mechanics show up when nothing else is working in extreme heat or cold. People drawn to the work tend to like the visibility of being the one who fixes it.

rows.title: How much does a carpenter make per year working in Vancouver?
rows.old_description: Follow the path behind Carpenter and see how real choices, training, and early experience can turn interest into direction.
rows.new_takeaway: Carpenter pay in cities like Vancouver scales sharply with years on tools. The number you find online is usually a midpoint, not what a first-year apprentice or a seasoned journeyman actually takes home.

rows.title: Do This to Make $2,000/Day with a Woodworking Business!
rows.old_description: Follow the path behind Cabinet Maker and see how real choices, training, and early experience can turn interest into direction.
rows.new_takeaway: High-revenue days in a woodworking business come from custom commercial work, not retail furniture. The path there runs through niche reputation, not better marketing.

rows.title: How a Successful Serial Entrepreneur Got Started! 🤯
rows.old_description: Follow the path behind Entrepreneurship and see how real choices, training, and early experience can turn interest into direction.
rows.new_takeaway: Most serial entrepreneurs started with a small, unglamorous first business. The repeatable skill is starting at all, not picking a winner the first time.

rows.title: Trying Different Things At A Young Age Helps Discover Our Passion | Honour The Work | Skilled
rows.old_description: Follow the path behind Skilled Trades and see how real choices, training, and early experience can turn interest into direction.
rows.new_takeaway: Career direction usually comes from trying enough small things to find what holds your attention. Waiting to commit until you're "sure" is the slow path; trying things is the fast one.

rows.title: Everyone Has A Different Path | Honour The Work | Skilled Trades
rows.old_description: Follow the path behind Misc and see how real choices, training, and early experience can turn interest into direction.
rows.new_takeaway: Career advice that worked for one person rarely transfers cleanly to another. The useful pattern in someone else's path is the way they made decisions — not the decisions themselves.

rows.title: How after an IT job I ended up as a car painter
rows.old_description: Follow the path behind Car Painting and see how real choices, training, and early experience can turn interest into direction.
rows.new_takeaway: Career pivots in your 20s and 30s are more common than they look. Most people end up doing work that wasn't on their radar at 18, and that's usually a good outcome, not a failure of planning.

rows.title: Job Talks OYAP - Auto Body Assistant
rows.old_description: Follow the path behind Autobody Repair and see how real choices, training, and early experience can turn interest into direction.
rows.new_takeaway: Auto body apprenticeship programs through high school let you start earning before graduation. The OYAP path turns a couple of years of part-time school work into a head start on the trade.

rows.title: From Grit to Precision: Will's Journey into CNC Machining
rows.old_description: Follow the path behind CNC Machining and see how real choices, training, and early experience can turn interest into direction.
rows.new_takeaway: CNC machining sits halfway between trades and tech. The people who thrive usually had hands-on mechanical experience first, then learned the programming side on the job.

rows.title: Want an IT Job? Start a Home Lab
rows.old_description: Follow the path behind IT – Network Systems Administration and see how real choices, training, and early experience can turn interest into direction.
rows.new_takeaway: Home labs are the fastest way into IT roles because they give you something concrete to talk about in interviews. Self-taught with proof beats certified with nothing built, in most hiring conversations.

rows.title: How much does a #SystemsAdministrator make?
rows.old_description: Follow the path behind IT – Network Systems Administration and see how real choices, training, and early experience can turn interest into direction.
rows.new_takeaway: Systems administrator pay ranges widely depending on the kind of infrastructure you run. The bands jump sharply when you specialize: cloud, security, or large-scale networks.

rows.title: How To Get Into The Animation Industry
rows.old_description: Follow the path behind 3D/2D Character Computer Animation and see how real choices, training, and early experience can turn interest into direction.
rows.new_takeaway: Breaking into animation is mostly about portfolio plus persistence. Studios hire from a small pool of people who keep showing them new work — not from cold applications alone.

rows.title: It took me 6 months to become a software developer 👩🏻‍💻
rows.old_description: Follow the path behind Web Technologies and see how real choices, training, and early experience can turn interest into direction.
rows.new_takeaway: Software development is one of the few professional careers people switch into in months instead of years. The catch: the first job is the hardest, and self-taught candidates have to make their work visible to get a chance.
